verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only general pull request and AGit review-and-merge workflows, plus dependencies on issues. Nothing shows stacked pull requests, per-member readiness in a stack, or ordered stack merging. Stacked PRs are a fair question for a Git forge, so this is an applicable axis with no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can split a large change into stacked pull requests, see each member's readiness, and merge the stack in order
